verdict.rationale: OpenCode's GitHub integration runs only when someone mentions /opencode or /oc in a comment, and the docs describe it as executing tasks or opening PRs for fixes and features. Nothing documents automatic review that fires on every pull request or posts contextual review feedback. The read-only plan agent's 'review suggestions' is a local session feature, not PR review, so both are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get automatic code review with contextual feedback on every pull request
